name: Dutch Core Vocabulary
description: Essential Dutch words and phrases with spaced repetition

cards.exampleSentence: Hallo, hoe gaat het met jou?

cards.exampleTranslation: Good morning, have a nice day!
Thank you very much for your help.

cards.exampleSentence: Hallo, ik heet Peter en ik woon in Amsterdam.
cards.exampleTranslation: Hello, my name is Peter and I live in Amsterdam.
May I have a glass of water?

cards.exampleSentence: We eten vers brood bij het ontbijt.
cards.exampleTranslation: We eat fresh bread at breakfast.
I drink coffee in the morning.

cards.exampleSentence: Het ontbijt is om acht uur.

cards.exampleTranslation: I want to be a teacher.
What are you going to do?
I want to go with you.
I want to get to know Amsterdam.
I want to see that film.

cards.exampleSentence: Kun je me het zout geven?
cards.exampleTranslation: Can you give me the salt?
Do you want something to drink?

cards.exampleSentence: De trein komt te laat aan.

cards.exampleTranslation: I want to buy a gift.

cards.exampleSentence: Het is moeilijk uit te leggen.
Ik wil, maar ik kan niet.
cards.exampleTranslation: I want to, but I can't.

cards.exampleSentence: Hoewel het laat is, ga ik uit.
cards.exampleTranslation: Although it's late, I'm going out.

cards.exampleSentence: Echter, ik ben het niet eens.
Het spijt me, ik ben laat.

cards.exampleTranslation: Excuse me, do you speak English?
Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Excuse me, can you help me?

cards.exampleSentence: Het boek ligt op de tafel.
cards.exampleTranslation: The book is on the table.
